title: Business Data Quality, Controlling und Auffälligkeitserkennung

source_basis.relevance: EDA, statistische Analyse, Zeitreihenprognosen und Tabellenanalyse liefern optionale Analysebausteine, aber keine Controlling-Fachlogik.
External skills remain pinned, selectively admitted and policy-gated behind an Ananta-native adapter.

repo_alignment.architecture: Ananta remains the server-side control plane. Deterministic accounting and data-quality rules execute before optional statistical or LLM-assisted analysis.
repo_alignment.integration: Use existing Sources, Context Policy, Approval, Audit, Artifact and CodeCompass boundaries. No external-skill type, secret or implicit capability reaches a public Ananta contract.
repo_alignment.storage: Raw input remains immutable and access-controlled; normalized datasets, findings, explanations and evidence get separate versioned artifact identities.

acceptance_summary: A user can import an authorized CSV/XLSX export, map its schema, run reproducible checks and receive findings with row/cell references and evidence.
Deterministic reconciliation and rule violations are strictly separated from statistical anomalies and LLM-generated explanations.
Each finding is traceable to dataset version, mapping, rule/model version, parameters, execution environment and approval state.
No data is sent externally, no business record is changed and no action is taken without explicit policy and approval.
non_goals: No replacement for ERP, accounting software, tax advice, audit opinion or legally binding accounting decisions.
No automatic posting, payment, correction, deletion or booking reversal.
No full K-Dense skill import; approved skills can only enrich the analysis through the selective adapter.

tasks.title: Canonical business-dataset and finding contracts define
files_to_create: A versioned schema module at the existing backend contract location, determined during implementation.
tasks.implementation: Define neutral contracts for dataset source/version, column mapping, period, currency, record locator, finding type, severity, evidence, confidence, disposition and immutable execution receipt. Do not model a particular ERP as the canonical format.
acceptance_criteria: Contracts distinguish deterministic violation, reconciliation mismatch, statistical anomaly and advisory explanation.
A record locator can reference CSV row or XLSX sheet/cell range without copying sensitive raw values into logs.
Schema evolution and unknown fields are fail-closed.
Contract tests prove stable IDs and backward-compatible read behavior.

tasks.title: Authorized import, profiling and schema mapping build
files_to_create: A controlling import/profile service and fixtures at paths selected after repository inventory.
files_to_modify: Existing source admission and artifact registration integration points, only after confirming their contracts.
tasks.implementation: Accept only approved CSV/XLSX sources through existing Source-Admission. Create an immutable profile: headers, types, nulls, duplicates, date/amount/currency validity and a user-confirmable source-to-canonical mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Macros, formulas as executable content, external links, path traversal and unsupported workbook objects are not executed.
Raw files remain access-controlled; profile reports aggregate values by default.
A mapping requires explicit confirmation before checks run.
Invalid date, decimal, currency and account fields produce bounded import findings instead of silent coercion.

tasks.title: Versioned deterministic controlling rule catalog implement
files_to_create: A declarative controlling-rule catalog and deterministic evaluator.
tasks.implementation: Provide auditable, declarative rules for required fields, duplicate invoice candidates, negative/zero amount policy, invalid period, missing/unknown cost center, currency mismatch, approval limit breach and configurable account/cost-center cross-checks. Rules may flag, never mutate.
acceptance_criteria: Every finding identifies its rule ID/version, exact parameters and bounded record locator.
Rule evaluation is deterministic, offline-capable and unit-testable without an LLM.
Tenant/project-specific threshold changes are versioned and approval-gated.
Duplicate detection distinguishes exact duplicates from similarity candidates and never silently suppresses records.

tasks.title: Reconciliation and variance checks add
files_to_create: Reconciliation and variance-check services with synthetic business-data fixtures.
tasks.implementation: Implement explicit checks for debit/credit or source/target totals, line-to-header totals, subtotal/tax/total relationships, period-over-period and budget-versus-actual variances. Every comparison declares tolerances and aggregation grain.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation reports expected, actual, difference, tolerance and included/excluded record counts.
Currency, time zone, fiscal period and rounding policy are explicit inputs.
Incomplete or mixed-grain data produces an inconclusive result, not a false pass.
Synthetic fixtures cover valid, tolerance-boundary, mismatch and incomplete-data cases.

tasks.title: Optional statistical anomaly and forecast adapter add
files_to_create: An Ananta-native statistical-analysis adapter and evaluation fixtures.
tasks.implementation: Behind the selective skills adapter, permit approved local/pinned EDA, statsmodels or forecasting capabilities for outlier scoring, residual diagnostics and prediction intervals. The adapter receives anonymized/minimized projections and returns findings, never raw upstream output as truth.
acceptance_criteria: Statistical findings name method, feature/time window, training/reference range, parameters, threshold and confidence.
A statistical anomaly cannot override deterministic reconciliation or accounting-rule results.
No model/package download or external API call happens without explicit preflight and approval.
Baseline tests quantify false-positive behavior on known seasonal and one-off business events.

tasks.title: Evidence-bounded explanation and investigation workflow add
tasks.implementation: Generate a concise explanation from only the recorded finding evidence, mapping and permitted related records. Clearly label calculation, anomaly hypothesis and requested human check separately.
acceptance_criteria: An explanation cannot invent data fields, causal claims or accounting decisions.
Each statement links to a rule, calculation or statistical receipt.
Prompt-injection text inside business-data fields is treated as data and cannot change the investigation or tool policy.
The output supports a human disposition: confirmed, false positive, needs data, or accepted exception.

tasks.title: Audit, provenance and CodeCompass projection connect
tasks.implementation: Project dataset receipt, schema mapping, rule/model version, execution result, human disposition and permitted source relationships into Ananta audit and CodeCompass without exposing raw sensitive values.
acceptance_criteria: A finding can be reconstructed from immutable input receipt and configuration versions.
CodeCompass explains why a finding exists and which source/version was used.
Access controls redact source values and restrict row/cell-level detail.
Historical findings remain reproducible after a rule is superseded or disabled.

tasks.title: Controlling workbench as real API-backed UI expose
files_to_create: Angular controlling workbench components after API contracts are accepted.
files_to_modify: Existing API routing/bootstrap only after route inventory.
tasks.implementation: Expose authorized imports, mapping review, run configuration, findings, evidence, disposition and export through actual versioned backend APIs. No browser-only calculation or mock state is accepted.
acceptance_criteria: The UI distinguishes rule violations, mismatches, anomalies and advisory explanations visually and textually.
Users see data version, rule/model version, confidence, evidence and approval requirement before follow-up action.
Filtering and exports preserve access rules and redaction.
End-to-end tests run import-to-disposition against real backend contracts.

tasks.title: Security, quality and staged rollout gate establish
files_to_create: A secrets-free acceptance report template and operator rollout documentation.
tasks.implementation: Run a pilot with synthetic data and read-only analysis; test tenant isolation, malformed files, formula/macro payloads, policy bypass, provenance tampering, false positives and degraded external-skill availability before enabling production data.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot starts with read-only, deterministic rules; statistical/LLM components remain opt-in.
A global and per-catalog disable switch stops new runs without deleting evidence.
No finding triggers a financial action automatically.
Release evidence records coverage, known limits, performance bounds and rollback verification.
